historicalSymbolQuery: Choose from the official catalog or enter an exact historical symbol. Searching creates no instrument and grants no trading permission.
watchlistEmpty: No watchlist instruments. Add from the official catalog; no example quotes are supplied.
watchlistUnavailable: Watchlist read failed. Read it again.
ordersScope: Latest ten orders; independent SIM accounts excluded. Orders are not fills.
overviewPurpose: Account performance, market data and independent SIM activity, with missing sources shown explicitly.
marketBoundary: Stored official OHLCV · Historical window · Not live prices
noMarket: Choose an instrument from the official catalog to read stored market data.
marketUnavailable: No active spot instruments in the catalog. Prepare instruments and data in Market & data; no example prices are generated here.
loaded: Default filters loaded. Refine the search; details keep their original object identity.
strategyTypeHelp: Types are maintained in code; availability does not imply execution support. Test and legacy definitions remain available for existing records.
localFactsScope: Local canonical facts only; independent SIM accounts are excluded. No private exchange refresh.
positionSourceLimit: Local position projection, not an external account snapshot. Quote currency and external valuation are unavailable; no account P&L is inferred.
lastTaskEventsLimit: One persisted event per task; this is not a complete event history.
taskSnapshotUnavailable: Task snapshot unavailable. Health is unknown.
noTaskFailures: No failures in the latest task snapshots
configDefinitionHelp: Create the name, type and account scope first, then configure version parameters in the detail form. This does not enable or run the strategy.
configDefinitionExtraHelp: Usually no extra fields are needed. Set the SMA window and target allocation in the next version form.
configSmaNext: Spot single SMA: set the window and target allocation in the next step. No configuration code is required.
configLegacyTypeHelp: This type supports historical or test definitions. No verified production parameter contract is available. Maintaining its configuration does not imply backtest or SIM execution support.
configVersionExtra: Additional version configuration (optional; inherits strategy configuration when blank)
configWindowHelp: Number of recent closed candles used for the average. A window of 20 means 20 candles, not 20 minutes.
configExposureHelp: Fraction of budget: 0.3 means 30%; 1 means 100%. This is not leverage. Execution remains subject to risk controls.
configAdvancedRequired: Check the structure and duplicate keys in the advanced editor. Configurations with over 100 top-level fields also require advanced editing. Original text is retained.
configNoExtra: No additional parameters. Keep the defaults unless needed.
configExactNumber: Enter a number; original precision is preserved
configIncomplete: Complete parameter names and values. Names must be unique; numbers and nested content must match their selected type.
configResearchHelp: Defaults and schema are research metadata. Backtests and SIM use the bound frozen strategy version; editing this metadata does not replace executable parameters. Selecting a dataset fills its source automatically.
configEvaluationHelp: The server computes the standard evaluation metrics. No custom configuration is needed. Optional metadata below does not add evaluation algorithms or thresholds.
configLegacyPaperHelp: Additional snapshots for legacy research Paper only. Fee sources inherit the original backtest contract and cannot be overridden here. Independent SIM uses the publication and budget form.
configNestedInspect: Nested content; expand the original snapshot to inspect
